anti_patterns.message: CRITICAL: Job 'build' performs deployment without upstream test gates ('needs:' block is empty).
anti_patterns.remediation: Add a 'needs:' dependency on a test or verification job before executing deployment steps.

anti_patterns.message: Job 'build' step 2 uses unpinned action 'Azure/setup-azd@v2'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).

anti_patterns.message: Job 'build' step 4 uses unpinned action 'azure/login@v1'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).

anti_patterns.message: Job 'build' step 5 uses unpinned action 'azure/CLI@v1'. Pin to a 40-character commit SHA.
anti_patterns.remediation: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).

anti_patterns.message: Workflow omits explicit 'permissions:' block, inheriting default GITHUB_TOKEN permissions.
anti_patterns.remediation: Declare explicit least-privilege 'permissions:' (for example, contents: read) at the workflow or job level.
Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).

anti_patterns.message: Job 'build' step 4 uses cloud authentication without OIDC 'id-token: write' or relies on static cloud keys.
anti_patterns.remediation: Configure short-lived OIDC federation with 'permissions: id-token: write' and replace long-lived static cloud keys.
